spec_match.rationale: Exercises the exact observable contract: with datagramsReadableType "bytes" the datagram readable grants a BYOB reader, without it a default stream refuses with TypeError — the behavioural difference the constructor-steps' 'set up with byte reading support' branch creates.

interactive.rationale: One button performs two real constructions and two real getReader({mode:'byob'}) calls; each side renders what was actually granted or thrown, with the winning state named.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises the two-construction comparison observable without a server, and that is the page.

edge_cases.rationale: Names all three real-world outcomes (new Chrome, legacy Chromium both-grant, option-ignoring engines both-refuse) plus an impossible-state branch flagged for upstream reporting; constructor-throw branches are handled per side.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus, the spec member, and the Streams BYOB reader section.

conformance.rationale: The suite's bytes-grants-byob-reader (passes even on 141 — the legacy byte stream honours the reader) and default-refuses-byob-reader (honestly fails on 141) pin this page's contract; verified executing 3 pass / 3 fail / 1 blocked.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 via the repo CDP harness (no chrome-devtools-mcp here): duel driven at 1280×900 and 360×740, both sides granted BYOB readers and the LEGACY verdict rendered with the flag pointer; overflowX 0, zero failed requests, only the intentional dead-endpoint net-layer lines. Partial: the 157+ split outcome (default refuses, bytes grants) needs a newer build.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts the observed state is one of the three legitimate ones; readers released and transports closed; all promises claimed.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; granted/refused sides outline emerald/rose with full text; buttons set background and color together.

accessibility.rationale: Each side's result is its own polite region, the verdict is styled text, the duel grid collapses to one column at narrow widths, native button.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Driven at both classes with 0px horizontal overflow; monospace constructor lines wrap; both screenshots read.

openQuestions.title: Capture the 157+ split verdict
openQuestions.detail: On a Chrome 157+ or flagged build, confirm the default side refuses with TypeError while the bytes side grants a ReadableStreamBYOBReader, and that the page names the new-Chrome state.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive side-by-side comparison panel collapsing on mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: auto-fit minmax grid so paired panels stack on narrow viewports without overflow.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The duel uses grid-template-columns repeat(auto-fit, minmax(260px,1fr)); verified stacked at 360px with 0px overflow.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible live region status readout for async API probe result
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Live regions for meaningful result text; avoid color-only outcomes.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Each side's result is an aria-live paragraph stating granted/refused with the constructor name or error; outlines reinforce but never replace the text.

summary: Two real constructions, two real BYOB reader requests, three named real-world outcomes. Verified with the repo headless-Chromium CDP harness (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud environment) on Chromium 141: both-grant legacy state detected and labelled, clean console/network, 0px overflow both classes.
